name: genesis-migration-reviewer
description: Independent, read-only reviewer for the Genesis Knowledge System migration (Phase 47). Verifies one sub-spec or batch: re-runs the checks, audits the tooling, samples source/ledger/new docs, checks every rule and lesson survived at full force, and writes a review report with a PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / FAIL verdict.

agentSpawn.command: echo "review started $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %z')"; echo "project-tracker HEAD $(git -C /Users/ramaswamy.u/repo/project-tracker log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null)"; echo "uncommitted files: $(git -C /Users/ramaswamy.u/repo/project-tracker status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; ls /Users/ramaswamy.u/repo/project-tracker/genesis/migration/reviews 2>/dev/null | tail -5

welcomeMessage: Genesis migration reviewer: give me the unit id (e.g. 47-04 B03) and I will verify it independently.
